spans.text: The Congression of Cineris Clade is a cult-like city of dark elves living in the depths below Retia, serving their supposed eponymous god despite being unaware of its true nature. They live by the light of its magma-like blood that pours eternally from its titanic body, and aim to one day awaken it from dormancy.

“Congression? No - cult. Dark elves are feared across Somnus Domina, mostly thanks to their mysterious nature, but all of those I’ve met have been friendly and refined. Every culture has certain inequalities, and this one is certainly skewed towards the lesser treatment of their men, but from what I have seen, they gain benefits accordingly. The Congression of Cineris Clade has no such gray area; their dark elves are murderous and wicked. I feel bad for those born into their ranks, only to be indoctrinated and twisted.”
